hypothesis: The isolated proof evaluated each approved excerpt separately and rejected a claim whose population was established by one excerpt and whose outcome was reported by an adjacent excerpt from the same claim. Reading the citation set for one claim together should accept that supported claim without accepting omitted qualifiers or combinations across different source chunks, experiments, conditions, documents, or claims.
change: The proof input now carries document, page and chunk provenance for every citation. The proof reads all citations for one claim together and allows a qualifier from one excerpt to apply to an outcome in another only when both come from the same cited source chunk and do not indicate different populations or conditions. The claim text itself must state every requested qualifier; excerpts cannot repair an omitted qualifier. Cross-chunk, cross-document and cross-condition combinations remain prohibited.

source.previous_outcome: r3 repair proof rejected a claim that included the requested population and whose two excerpts came from the same source chunk

Each variant used one stochastic proof call. Repeated trials are required before claiming a reliability improvement.
